name: game-world
title: Game World
description: One shared room for the browser games (RC cars, Stage Skirmish, Stage Salad): each game sees the others' cars, soldiers, vegetables and slingshots in the same venue, they affect each other (server-refereed, capped, never griefing), a world host page (start / stop all, one presenter-safe pause, join codes side by side) and a world spectator page. Needs no game; does nothing until a game session runs. Never puts anything on a screen.
